about: Prompt caching on the Anthropic gate (owner approval 2026-10-12). When the engine's framed system text carries its per-call marker tail (separator "\n\n--- PER-CALL MARKERS (engine) ---"), the app's adapter (packages/providers/src/anthropic-messages.ts) sends `system` as exactly two text blocks: the stable prefix up to and including the blank line before the marker line, with cache_control {"type":"ephemeral"} (5 minutes), then the tail starting with the marker line, with no mark; the two texts joined give back the system text byte for byte. `sent` bodies are written out by hand in the adapter's key order and serializer (JSON.stringify), each with the reservation the app computes for its exact bytes: the whole input at the 5-minute cache-write price ((bytes + 2048) x 0.125 + 32768 x 0.50 per million at the lower step). `refused` bodies break the shape. The adapter must produce every `sent` body (tests/unit/preview-anthropic-gate.test.ts), the app's guarded fetch must accept each at exactly its reservedUsd and refuse every `refused` one (same file), and the gate's AnthropicProfile.body_valid and validate_request must do the same (tests/unit/preview_budget_authority_anthropic_test.py).

--- END PER-CALL MARKERS ---"}],"output_config":{"effort":"high"}}
